pathways.description: Standard IHSS eligibility: a Medi-Cal recipient who needs in-home help to live safely at home.

criteria.description: The care recipient resides in California.
The care recipient has Medi-Cal (IHSS generally requires it).
The care recipient lives in their own home, not a hospital or facility.
The recipient's functional limitations meet IHSS's need-for-assistance standard.
criteria.question: Do the recipient's reported daily-living limitations and conditions meet the IHSS standard for needing in-home supportive services to remain safely at home?

criteria.description: A county social worker assesses functional needs and authorizes service hours.
criteria.external_note: The county IHSS office conducts an in-home assessment to determine authorized hours. Ilera cannot establish this; it can only help the applicant prepare.
